game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Scorpion Canyon, a canyon of scorpions: the desert nomad must handle mirage spirits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Pseudocode Bridge: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap.
theme: Sand Dunes – Scorpion Canyon: a canyon of scorpions
core_gameplay_loop: In Scorpion Canyon, repeat each round: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the bridge value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the water well using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The water well reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the water well is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 9 (extended tier): Pseudocode Bridge
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pseudocode Bridge' (Week 9 slot 11), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Scorpion Canyon'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bridge changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mirage spirits in Scorpion Canyon.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The water well reached with actions_used <= 14.
